def zip_rows(destination, prefix, rows, generated):
    if len({r['path'] for r in rows}) != len(rows):
        raise ValueError('Duplicate archive file path')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(destination, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6) as archive:
        for entry in rows:
            if sha(entry['source']) != entry['sha256']:
                raise ValueError(f'Source changed during packaging: {entry["source"]}')
            archive.write(entry['source'], f'{prefix}/{entry["path"]}')
        for name, data in generated.items():
            info = zipfile.ZipInfo(f'{prefix}/{name}')
            info.external_attr = (stat.S_IFREG | 0o644) << 16
            archive.writestr(info, json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
